user.title: Mower
user.description: Pick the Mammotion mower. Luba Scheduler finds its activity, battery, RTK, camera and zone entities from the device, so later renames in the Mammotion integration don't break it.

zones.title: Zone groups
zones.description: Split the mower's zones into two groups. Each mow day cuts one group, and the groups never share a day.

inputs.title: Conditions
inputs.description: The sensors that decide whether it is a good time to mow (permission) and whether a running mow must stop (danger). Optional inputs that are left empty simply never trip.

data_description.mow_allowed_a_entity: Optional. While this is not on, Group A is treated as held for overseeding. Unavailable counts as held.
data_description.mow_allowed_b_entity: Optional. While this is not on, Group B is treated as held for overseeding. Unavailable counts as held.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The mower is never started while the gate is open. An unavailable gate sensor always counts as open.

error.missing_roles: This device is missing entities Luba Scheduler needs: {missing}. Is it a Mammotion mower, and is the integration loaded?
error.no_zones: This mower has no zone switches yet. Create zones in the Mammotion app first.
error.empty_group: Each group needs at least one zone.
error.overlapping_groups: A zone can belong to only one group.

mower.title: Mower
mower.description: Pick the Mammotion mower. Changing to a different mower clears the zone groups.

zones.title: Zone groups
zones.description: Split the mower's zones into two groups. Each mow day cuts one group.

inputs.title: Conditions
inputs.description: Clear an optional field to stop using it.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The mower is never started while the gate is open. An unavailable gate sensor always counts as open.

data.cutoff_before_sunset_minutes: No new mow within this long of sunset
data.canopy_max_f: Hottest canopy temperature (above this, a running mow stops)
data.precip_chance_max: Start only while precipitation chance is below
data.lightning_radius: Lightning radius (in the distance sensor's unit)
data.lightning_recency_minutes: A strike counts for this long
data.fresh_start_battery_floor: Battery needed for a fresh start
data.optimal_delay_minutes: Conditions must hold this long before they count
data.angle_options: Mowing angles to rotate through (degrees, comma-separated)
data.spacing_options: Path spacings to rotate through (cm, comma-separated)

error.missing_roles: This device is missing entities Luba Scheduler needs: {missing}.
error.no_zones: This mower has no zone switches yet.
error.empty_group: Each group needs at least one zone.
error.overlapping_groups: A zone can belong to only one group.
error.canopy_range: The hottest temperature must be above the coolest.
error.bad_list: Enter distinct whole numbers separated by commas, within the allowed range.

options.on_closed: On means the gate is closed
options.on_open: On means the gate is open (door/contact sensors)

dead_bindings.title: Mower entities are missing
dead_bindings.description: These can no longer be found: {names}. A zone the mower rebuilt (for example after merging or renaming zones in the Mammotion app) is a new zone. Re-pick it under Luba Scheduler → Configure → Zone groups (or Mower).

start_mow_drift.title: Mammotion changed its start command
start_mow_drift.description: mammotion.start_mow's fields changed. Added: {added}. Removed: {removed}. A new field gets a default Luba Scheduler never chose, so review it before the next mow and update Luba Scheduler.

start_mow_unreadable.title: Can't read Mammotion's start command
start_mow_unreadable.description: Luba Scheduler could not read the fields of mammotion.start_mow, so it cannot tell whether a Mammotion update changed them.

entity_id_taken.title: A Luba Scheduler entity got a different id
entity_id_taken.description: {expected} was already taken, so Home Assistant created {actual} instead. Remove or rename the old entity that holds {expected}, then reload Luba Scheduler.
